Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Standard SIG intake request for BrightLeaf vendor review

Hi Alex and Marissa,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our vendor review. Attached is BrightLeaf's SIG intake workbook (we consolidated questions this year). We need the completed SIG and supporting evidence for sections marked 'required' within 3 weeks to stay on our procurement timeline.

High-level asks:
- Confirm an internal point of contact for each SIG section (we've listed section names in column A).
- Tell us who will provide evidence artifacts and approximate delivery dates.
- If any section requires more than 5 business days to compile, flag it so we can adjust expectations.

Attachments: BrightLeaf_SIG_Request_2027.pdf (the questionnaire)

Can we do a 30-minute intake call tomorrow to run the roster and flag hard sections? My team is available 10:00-12:00 PT.

Thanks,
Lina Hsu
Senior Information Security Manager
BrightLeaf Financial

BrightLeaf Procurement <procurement@brightleaf.com> was copied on the original request for scheduling and procurement notes.

Hi Lina — thanks for the questionnaire and timeline. We can take this on. 30 minutes tomorrow at 10:30 PT works for our core intake crew; I'll send a calendar invite.

Before the call I put together a lightweight runbook so we can run through section ownership quickly and capture availability. I'll upload a draft roster to Drive and share during the meeting.

Proposed intake agenda (30 min):
1) Quick intro and timeline constraints (5 min)
2) Walk the questionnaire high-level and identify 'required' sections (10 min)
3) Propose owners and delivery windows (10 min)
4) Confirm next steps and evidence handoff (5 min)

I've attached a draft XLS with a suggested owner column so we can mark changes in the meeting (SIG-Section-Roster-draft.xlsx).

See you tomorrow.

— Alex
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference
